description.ja: 1984年創業。博多直送の濃厚豚骨スープが自慢。秋葉原の人気ラーメン店で、多くの外国人観光客にも愛されています。英語メニュー完備。
description.en: Since 1984, Kyushu Jangara has served rich Hakata-style tonkotsu ramen from Fukuoka. The Akihabara branch is beloved by international visitors for its creamy pork-bone broth, thin straight noodles, and customizable toppings. English menus available.

nearestStation: Akihabara Station — 2 min walk (Electric Town Exit)

menu.description: The original. Milky-white pork-bone broth, thin Hakata-straight noodles, chashu pork, green onion.
Same rich tonkotsu base with house chili blend. Spice levels 1–5 available on request.
Classic tonkotsu topped with a soy-marinated soft-boiled egg. Most popular bowl.
Extra serving of thin noodles added directly to your remaining broth. A Hakata tradition.

steps.en: Insert cash — the machine accepts ¥500, ¥1,000, ¥5,000 and ¥10,000 notes. IC cards (Suica / Pasmo) are also accepted.
steps.ja: お金を入れてください（現金またはICカード対応）

steps.en: Press the button for your chosen ramen. Each button shows the name and price. Photo guides are posted on the wall beside the machine.
steps.ja: 食べたいラーメンのボタンを押してください

steps.en: Collect your ticket(s) from the slot at the bottom. Change and receipts come out separately.
steps.ja: 食券を受け取ってください

steps.en: Wait to be seated. When a staff member shows you to your seat, hand them your ticket face-up.
steps.ja: 着席後、店員に食券を手渡してください

steps.en: For extra noodles (kaedama), raise your hand and say 'kaedama kudasai' (替え玉ください) when your bowl is almost empty.
steps.ja: 替え玉を頼むときは「替え玉ください」とお声がけください

description.ja: 完全植物性スープで作る本格ラーメン専門店。昆布と椎茸の旨味たっぷりのだしを使用。ヴィーガン・ベジタリアンの方も安心。ハラール認証取得済み。
description.en: A 100% plant-based ramen shop tucked in the bookseller district of Jimbocho. Kombu and shiitake dashi form the soul of every bowl. All broths, noodles, and toppings are certified vegan and halal-friendly.

name.ja: 塩ヴィーガンラーメン

menu.description: Delicate sea salt broth with kombu dashi, wheat noodles, seasonal vegetable toppings, yuzu zest.

name.ja: 味噌ヴィーガンラーメン

menu.description: Rich hatcho-miso blend with tofu, bamboo shoots, corn, mushrooms, and ginger.
Sesame-chili broth with plant-based minced, bok choy. Mild to medium spice.

tagline.en: Sichuan-fired ramen — choose your heat, level 1 to 10

description.ja: 四川風の激辛ラーメン専門店。辛さレベル1〜10でオーダー可能。レベル8以上はチャレンジャーの証。担々麺・激辛ラーメンが人気。
description.en: Sichuan-inspired tantanmen and fiery ramen near Ogawamachi Station. Choose heat from Level 1 (gentle warmth) to Level 10 (extreme challenge). Regulars proudly display their Level 10 badges on the wall of fame.

menu.description: Sesame-chili broth, spiced minced pork, bok choy, green onion. Select your spice level.
Rich pork-miso broth with a triple-chili blend. Recommended for spice lovers only. Level 5+ only.

steps.en: Insert cash — accepts ¥100/¥500 coins and ¥1,000/¥5,000/¥10,000 notes. No IC cards.
steps.ja: 現金を投入（ICカード不可）

steps.en: Select your ramen using the photo buttons. Then press the spice level button (1–10) on the right panel.
steps.ja: ラーメンと辛さレベル（1〜10）を選択

steps.en: Collect your tickets — you'll receive one ticket per item ordered.
steps.ja: 食券を取り出してください

steps.en: Sit at the counter and place your tickets face-up in front of you. Staff will collect them.
steps.ja: カウンターに座り、食券を手前に置いてください

name.ja: ハラールラーメン 秋葉

tagline.en: Japan Halal Association certified — welcoming all guests

description.ja: 日本ハラール協会認証取得済み。豚肉・アルコール不使用の鶏ベーススープ。ムスリムの方も安心して本格的な日本のラーメンをお楽しみいただけます。
description.en: Certified by the Japan Halal Association. Broth is made from free-range halal chicken and vegetables — zero pork, zero alcohol. Arabic and Malay menus available. Prayer room directions provided on request.

nearestStation: Akihabara Station — 5 min walk (Electric Town Exit)

menu.description: Clear golden chicken broth with soy tare, halal chicken chashu, bamboo shoots, nori.
Creamy miso-chicken broth, thick wavy noodles, corn, butter, halal chicken slices.

tagline.en: Tokyo's finest dipping ramen — a ritual you'll never forget

description.ja: 濃厚魚介豚骨のつけダレに太麺をつけて食べる本格つけ麺。〆のスープ割りも絶品。ミシュランビブグルマン掲載店。
description.en: Thick wavy noodles served cold alongside a rich fish-and-pork dipping broth. Finish by adding warm dashi (soup-wari) to dilute the remaining broth into a satisfying soup. Listed in Michelin Bib Gourmand.

menu.description: Cold thick noodles + rich fish-pork dipping broth. Noodle refills (kaedama) free until 14:30.
Same price as regular — big eaters welcome.

steps.en: Insert coins or ¥1,000 bills only. No IC cards, no large notes.
steps.ja: 硬貨または千円札を投入（ICカード不可）

steps.en: Choose noodle size: 並 (nami, 200g) or 大 (oo, 300g) — same price. Then select any toppings.
steps.ja: 麺量（並・大）とトッピングを選択

steps.en: Take your ticket and stand in the queue. Seats are counter-only.
steps.ja: 食券を取り、カウンターの空席をお待ちください

steps.en: When your noodles arrive, dip them into the hot broth. When finished, ask for 'soup-wari' (スープ割り) — staff will add dashi to the remaining broth.
steps.ja: 麺を食べ終わったら「スープ割りください」と声をかけてください

name.ja: 北の大地 味噌ラーメン

tagline.en: Hokkaido's soul in a bowl — rich miso, butter, and corn

description.ja: 北海道直送の白味噌をベースに、濃厚な豚骨と鶏白湯を合わせた贅沢な一杯。甘みのあるとうもろこしとバターが絶妙にマッチします。
description.en: Hokkaido-sourced white miso blended with rich pork-bone and chicken paitan broth. Crowned with sweet corn, a pat of butter, and bamboo shoots. A warming taste of Japan's north.

menu.description: House-blend white miso, thick wavy noodles, corn, butter, chashu, bamboo shoots, bean sprouts.
Same rich miso base with togarashi chili paste stirred in. Medium heat.

steps.en: Insert your payment at the machine by the entrance.
steps.ja: 入口脇の券売機でお支払いを

steps.en: Select your bowl and any optional toppings.
steps.ja: メニューとトッピングを選択

steps.en: Bring the ticket to the counter and take a seat.
steps.ja: 食券をカウンターに持参し、着席ください

tagline.en: Japan's vegan ramen pioneer — colourful, plant-powered bowls

description.ja: 日本のヴィーガンラーメンの先駆者。パプリカを練り込んだ麺と、野菜だけのスープで作る「野菜ソバ」が代表作。健康志向の旅行者やベジタリアンに大人気。グルテンフリーオプション有り。
description.en: A pioneer of vegan ramen in Japan. Their signature 'Vegan Veggie Soba' features noodles kneaded with paprika and a rich soup made entirely from vegetables. Perfect for health-conscious travellers and vegetarians. Gluten-free options available.

nearestStation: Kojimachi Station — 1 min walk (Exit 1, Yurakucho Line)

menu.description: Paprika-kneaded noodles in a rich all-vegetable broth, topped with seasonal vegetables and herbs. Signature dish.
Delicate sea salt broth with silken tofu, kombu dashi, and green onions.

steps.en: Select the 'Vegan' category from the top menu on the machine screen. The machine has full English support.
steps.ja: 機械の画面でヴィーガンカテゴリを選択（英語対応）

steps.en: Choose your favourite toppings from the add-on screen.
steps.ja: トッピングを選択してください

steps.en: Insert cash or tap your IC card (Suica / Pasmo).
steps.ja: 現金またはICカードで支払い

steps.en: Hand the printed ticket to the staff when seated.
steps.ja: 着席後、食券を店員に渡す

name.ja: カラシビ味噌らー麺 鬼金棒

tagline.en: Karashibi — fiery chilli meets Sichuan numbing pepper

description.ja: 「辛さ」と「しびれ」の2種類のレベルをカスタマイズできる名物カラシビ味噌らー麺。鬼をテーマにした個性的な内装も人気。辛さとしびれの組み合わせを事前にリサーチして行くのがおすすめ。
description.en: Famous for 'Karashibi' — a dual-fire combination of chilli heat (Kara) and Szechuan numbing pepper (Shibi). Customise both levels independently. The demon-themed interior makes for a memorable dining experience.

menu.description: Rich miso broth with dual spice: Kara (chilli heat) and Shibi (Szechuan numbing). Choose your level of each independently.

steps.en: Buy your ticket at the machine outside the restaurant — there may be a queue before you enter.
steps.ja: まず店外の券売機でチケットを購入（入店前）

steps.en: Enter the shop and give the ticket to the staff when seated. English labels are on the buttons.
steps.ja: 入店後、着席したら店員に食券を渡す

steps.en: Staff will ask for your 'Kara' (辛さ, chilli) and 'Shibi' (しびれ, numbing) levels: Low (少なめ) / Medium (普通) / High (多め).
steps.ja: 辛さとしびれのレベルを伝えてください

tagline.en: The tsukemen legend — inside Tokyo Station itself

description.ja: 東京駅一番街地下1階「東京ラーメンストリート」に位置する、濃厚魚介豚骨つけ麺の名店。行列必至だが回転が速い。東京観光とセットで立ち寄れる。
description.en: Located in 'Tokyo Ramen Street' (Tokyo Station B1F). This shop helped define the thick-soup Tsukemen style beloved across Japan. Expect a queue — it moves fast. A true Tokyo landmark perfectly combined with sightseeing.

address: Tokyo Station B1F Tokyo Ramen Street, 1-9-1 Marunouchi, Chiyoda, Tokyo 100-0005
closed: Open every day (follows Tokyo Station hours)
nearestStation: Tokyo Station — directly inside (Yaesu South Exit B1F)

menu.description: Thick wavy noodles + rich fish-pork dipping broth. Regular / Large / Extra Large at the same price.

steps.en: Line up in the queue — staff will guide you toward the machine when you are near the front.
steps.ja: 行列に並ぶと、スタッフが券売機へ案内してくれます

steps.en: Use the touch-screen machine — it has an English language option. Select your noodle size and toppings.
steps.ja: タッチパネル式（英語選択可）。麺量とトッピングを選択

steps.en: Once seated, place your ticket face-up on the counter in front of you.
steps.ja: 着席後、食券を目の前のカウンターに表向きに置く

steps.en: When finished, ask for 'soup-wari' (スープ割り) — staff add hot dashi to your remaining broth for a finishing soup.
steps.ja: 食べ終わったら「スープ割りください」と声をかける

tagline.en: Refined Chuka Soba — two noodle types, one elegant bowl

description.ja: 伝統と洗練が融合した中華そばの名店。2種類の麺が一つの丼に盛られる独自のスタイルと、上品な煮干し出汁が特徴。静かで禅を感じる雰囲気。神保町の隠れた名店。
description.en: Elegant and traditional. Their signature bowl serves two types of noodles side by side in a refined niboshi (dried sardine) broth. Staff wear traditional attire. A calm, Zen-like atmosphere unlike any other ramen shop.

menu.description: Two types of noodles — thick and thin — in one bowl, with a refined niboshi-shoyu broth.
The signature bowl topped with a soy-marinated soft-boiled egg.

steps.en: Purchase your ticket at the machine near the entrance. Basic English labels are available.
steps.ja: 入口近くの券売機でチケットを購入（英語ラベルあり）

steps.en: Staff in traditional uniform will show you to your seat. Enjoy the calm atmosphere.
steps.ja: 和装のスタッフが席に案内してくれます

steps.en: Place your ticket on the small tray in front of you — staff will collect it.
steps.ja: 食券を手前のトレーに置いてください

steps.en: When finishing, say 'Gochisou-sama' (ごちそうさま) to thank the chef — a beloved Japanese custom.
steps.ja: 食べ終わったら「ごちそうさまでした」と伝えましょう

name.ja: 麺屋 武蔵 武骨外伝

tagline.en: Samurai-themed ramen — legendary kakuni pork belly in Akihabara

description.ja: サムライをテーマにした個性的な内装で知られる濃厚醤油らーめん店。とろとろに煮込んだ大きな角煮が名物。肉好きには外せない一軒。秋葉原の人気ラーメン店のひとつ。
description.en: Known for the huge, melt-in-your-mouth Kakuni (braised pork belly) topping. The interior is decorated with Samurai-themed art — dramatic and memorable. A must-visit for meat lovers exploring Akihabara.

nearestStation: Akihabara Station — 5 min walk (Electric Town Exit)

menu.description: Rich shoyu broth with thick wavy noodles and a substantial braised pork-belly kakuni.
Three pieces of melt-in-your-mouth braised pork belly on a rich shoyu base. For serious meat lovers.

steps.en: Check the photo buttons on the machine screen to identify your bowl.
steps.ja: 機械の画面で写真を確認してください

steps.en: Regular, Large, and Extra Large noodles are often the same price — choose freely.
steps.ja: 並・大・特大は同料金のことが多いです

steps.en: Select your size and any toppings, then pay. The machine accepts coins and ¥1,000 notes.
steps.ja: 麺量とトッピングを選んでお支払い（硬貨・千円札対応）
